verdict.rationale: The pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Drata itself. The MCP server and the "enable AI agents to interact with Drata" material describe external agents acting on Drata data, which belongs to a different story. The Trust Center Analytics Dashboard and Risk Assessment articles are titles only and do not describe AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
